metadata.description: Matt's shared Claude Code skills: PR, security, accessibility, performance and Dependabot review, repo setup and maintenance, side-project workflow, plus curated development and design skills from upstream authors.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Verified, graded PR review (with accessibility and performance angles when they apply) plus standalone security, accessibility and performance audits. Used by the Claude review GitHub Action, and run by a hook before a Claude session marks its own PR ready.

plugins.name: dependency-review
plugins.description: Reviews Dependabot PRs: real diff, advisory reachability with evidence, supply-chain vetting of every new version. Used by the Dependabot review GitHub Action.

plugins.name: repo-setup
plugins.description: Baseline files, settings and workflows for every new or existing repo: CI with coverage report, Dependabot, changelog, ADR template, bundle-size and Lighthouse checks, Claude reviews, docs drift check, security settings.

plugins.name: maintenance
plugins.description: release (changelog and release notes from merged PRs, tag and GitHub release), docs-check (README, docs, ADRs and privacy page against the code, on request or as a monthly drift issue), adr (decision records), health-check (weekly read-only summary of what needs attention across the repos) and test-gaps (riskiest untested code, then tests for it).

plugins.name: side-projects
plugins.description: new-project, portfolio-tool and project-tickets: Matt's side-project workflow.

plugins.name: cover-art
plugins.description: Minimalist, representational 16:10 cover illustrations for websites, apps, extensions and skills, made from the project's repo, purpose and colours.

plugins.name: linewash
plugins.description: Spot illustrations for empty states, error pages, onboarding and success screens: one bold ink line, pale two-tone washes, a backdrop circle, floating accents, dashed ground lines.

plugins.name: web-design-guidelines
plugins.description: UI and accessibility review against Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines. Vendored (MIT).

plugins.name: interaction-design
plugins.description: Microinteractions, motion, transitions and loading states with timing, easing and reduced-motion guidance. Vendored (MIT).

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic's skill for distinctive, production-grade frontend design instead of generic AI aesthetics (Apache-2.0, upstream).

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: Searchable local database of UI styles, palettes, font pairings, charts and per-stack UX rules (MIT, upstream).

plugins.name: interface-design
plugins.description: Design engineering: visual hierarchy, a strict design review, and design decisions kept across sessions (MIT, upstream).

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: obra/superpowers: brainstorming, writing and executing plans, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion, code review, subagent-driven development and worktrees (MIT, upstream).
